ledger: Woman's left hand | holding red apple, stable grip | holding red apple | claps with an extra phantom hand starting at 00:02
Woman's right hand | holding umbrella shaft | holding umbrella shaft | maintains grip throughout

findings.description: An extra hand appears and claps against the woman's left hand (which is holding the apple), while her actual right arm and hand are simultaneously visible holding the umbrella on her right side.
As the woman turns and the camera pans around her, the shaft of the umbrella passes directly through her shoulder and neck area instead of moving around her body.
